title: AdCP 3.2 canonical format classification vectors
description: Realistic, fictional publisher-spec descriptions with the expected buyer-deliverable canonical classification. Classification follows the creative payload and rendering responsibility, not the richness of placement behavior.

vectors.publisher_spec: A video begins in the article player and docks into a corner while the reader scrolls. The buyer supplies an MP4 file and landing URL; the publisher owns the player and docking behavior.
vectors.reason: The buyer deliverable is a hosted video file. Docking is placement or renderer behavior, not creative structure.

vectors.publisher_spec: A video begins inline and docks while scrolling. The buyer supplies a third-party JavaScript tag URL; the third party renders and measures the experience.
vectors.reason: Anything delivered as an opaque third-party display tag is display_tag even when the rendered behavior includes video or multiple states.

vectors.publisher_spec: The buyer supplies a logo, hero image, headline, body, call to action, and landing URL. The publisher composes and rearranges those components across viewport sizes.
vectors.reason: The seller algorithmically composes multiple buyer assets; this is not a single responsive image or a buyer-supplied HTML bundle.

vectors.publisher_spec: The buyer supplies one image and landing URL. The image may scale within a declared aspect-ratio and dimension range; no components are rearranged.
vectors.reason: Responsive sizing alone does not make a creative responsive_creative; the buyer payload is still one image.

vectors.publisher_spec: One masthead placement expands inline and later collapses into a sticky scroll state. The buyer supplies separate artwork for each state and a shared landing URL.
vectors.reason: The buyer deliverable has multiple deterministic seller-rendered states, which AdCP 3.2 represents directly as seller_rendered_stateful_display.

vectors.publisher_spec: One manifest supplies a masthead, page skin, and preroll together. The buyer supplies component-specific artwork plus a shared video and call to action.
vectors.reason: Several declared placements supplied atomically with shared assets form coordinated_placements rather than one stateful display unit. Inventory exclusivity is expressed separately on Product.

vectors.publisher_spec: The buyer uploads a ZIP containing index.html, JavaScript, images, clickTag support, and a backup image. The publisher unpacks and hosts it.
vectors.reason: A buyer-supplied bundle hosted by the seller is html5; display_tag is reserved for opaque externally served markup or URLs.
